rationale: The piece uses full ring-announcer grammar (booming ANNOUNCER, all-caps cues, entrance music and pyrotechnics), treats the windbreakers as sacred/championship regalia, bills specialties (e.g., TAG-TEAM TERROR of Trespassing) and makes the cul-de-sac a popping arena moment.
quote: They are the UNDISPUTED CHAMPIONS of Code Enforcement! The TAG-TEAM TERROR of Trespassing!
